sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Ownership and Cross-Border Sub-Licensing of Trademarks and Patents

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (unitary national jurisdiction; Bogotá D.C. as primary registry seat)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (unitary national; French/Napoleonic lineage through Código de Comercio Decreto 410 de 1971; no Sharia or sub-state doctrinal variation)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA, in force 15 May 2012)
Colombia–EU Multilateral Trade Agreement (in force 1 August 2013)
OECD Multilateral Convention to Implement Tax Treaty Related Measures (MLI)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 1258 de 2008 (S.A.S. regime, Arts. 3-11); Ley 526 de 1999 and Decreto 1916 de 2014 (UIAF AML/CFT framework); Decreto 830 de 2021 (Beneficiario Final definition and UIAF reporting, 5% ownership/control threshold); Resolución UIAF 314 de 2021 (sectoral SARLAFT obligations); Superintendencia de Sociedades Circular Externa 009 de 2016, Libro X, Título IV (SAGRILAFT/PISIS); Resolución DIAN 000164 de 2021 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales - RUBF).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of foreign parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry of parent's jurisdiction (e.g., Delaware Division of Corporations; UK Companies House)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Colombia has been a contracting party since 2001); non-Hague issuers require consular legalization at a Colombian embassy

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of foreign parent (with certified Spanish translation)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign company registry / competent commercial authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; must be accompanied by an official Spanish translation issued by a certified translator

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Special Power of Attorney granted to the Colombian incorporator or local agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of the grantor's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, followed by official translation; the legalized power of attorney enables execution of the S.A.S. private instrument before a Colombian notary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public / authorized certifying officer in the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; original signatures must be witnessed in accordance with Colombian notarial rules

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies of all shareholders, directors, legal representatives, and UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy plus Apostille (if requested by the receiving Colombian registry); data must be synchronized with OFAC/UN/domestic sanctions screening

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation and periodic (at least annual) screening of shareholders, directors, and UBOs against: (i) OFAC SDN and sectoral sanctions lists; (ii) UN Security Council Consolidated List; (iii) EU and UK consolidated sanctions lists; (iv) Colombian national alerts and Consejo de Seguridad Nacional lists; (v) PEP registries held by the Procuraduría General de la Nación, Fiscalía, and UIAF. Any match requires enhanced due diligence, filing of a suspicious operations report (ROS) via UIAF's SIREL platform within 5 business days, and may disqualify the UBO/shareholder under Ley 526 de 1999 and Circular 009 de 2016.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) operated by Confecámaras, with name homologación processed through the Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá online platform
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in Spanish or in Latin-alphabet script that is phonetically consistent in Spanish; the statutory suffix 'Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada' or abbreviation 'S.A.S.' is mandatory; foreign proper names and technical terms are acceptable, but transliteration must avoid notoria similitud with pre-registered companies.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: S.A. / Ltda. suffix non-compliant with the S.A.S. legal form
Any denomination reproducing a registered trademark or a previously registered comparable trade name
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name denial, the applicant must file a written recurso de reposición with the issuing Cámara de Comercio within 10 business days of notification under Ley 1437 de 2011, attaching a new no-similarity certificate for an alternative name; if the denial is upheld, the applicant may file recurso de apelación before the Superintendencia de Sociedades within 10 further business days. During the appeal, an alternative name may be reserved simultaneously via RUES to avoid incorporation delays.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for a non-regulated IP HoldCo S.A.S.: a virtual office (domiciliación de empresas) held by a licensed agent satisfies the legal domicile and judicial-notification address requirement, provided the entity maintains real administrative substance (management decisions, books, contracts, and banking instructions executed in Colombia) and the registered address is accepted by DIAN and the Cámara de Comercio for tax and registry notices.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 15-20% probability of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 24 months; the Superintendencia de Sociedades (vigilancia category) and DIAN may visit the registered office periodically, and intercompany royalty flows above USD 500,000 per annum materially increase transfer-pricing audit and on-site inspection risk.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and no-similarity homologación certificate (RUES)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official registry tariff for name homologación

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal drafting of S.A.S. bylaws (estatutos) and incorporation minutes
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark (flat fee for an IP-licensing-oriented S.A.S.)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company registration (matrícula mercantil) and filing of incorporation instrument with Cámara de Comercio
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration tariff based on subscribed capital (approx. COP 250,000 for minimum capital)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of private incorporation document and power-of-attorney signatures
Registration of corporate books (actas and accionistas) with Cámara de Comercio
Apostilles and/or consular legalization of five foreign corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority of document origin (e.g., U.S. Secretary of State; Colombian MFA for authentication)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Hague Apostille Convention per-document state fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Official Spanish translation (traducción oficial) of parent charter, good-standing certificate, and power of attorney
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate per page (approx. USD 10-20/page)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO, PEP, and sanctions screening (OFAC, UN, EU, UK, and Colombian national lists) for all shareholders and directors
Drafting of AML/CFT compliance manual (PISIS/SAGRILAFT program) and compliance officer nomination
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark aligned with Superintendencia de Sociedades Circular 009/2016 requirements

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: DIAN tax registration (NIT/RUT), signature authorization, and pre-incorporation tax profile setup
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: DIAN administrative procedure is free; charge reflects professional handling fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and virtual commercial office (domiciliación) for year one
Bank account opening coordination (banking KYC pack, signature cards, company documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for pre-banking KYC file assembly

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Law 1258 of 2008) establishing the Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada, Arts. 4-5 (no minimum capital and private incorporation document), Arts. 17-20 (registered office and share capital), in subsidiary application with Código de Comercio Arts. 110-373 and Decreto 2153 de 1992 (Chamber of Commerce registry rules).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Confecámaras - Registro Único Empresarial (RUES); local execution by Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá, with oversight by Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation document) with notarial signature authentication; public deed available as an alternative
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum legal capital; share capital is freely fixed in the bylaws, may be zero, and unpaid subscriptions may be paid in installments up to 2 years; no escrow account or proof-of-payment record is required at formation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the incorporation document of the Company, subscribed by all founding shareholders, is ratified and accepted in its entirety. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the initial share subscriptions and the capital payment schedule set in the bylaws are confirmed; that the registered office at the address stated in the charter is adopted; and that the following officers are appointed: Legal Representative, Alternate Legal Representative, and Treasurer-Secretary, each to serve until replacement. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the opening of corporate bank accounts, the recordal of intellectual property license agreements before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio, and all ancillary filings with the Chamber of Commerce, DIAN, and municipal authorities are authorized. All resolutions take effect immediately upon adoption.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá - RUES online portal (www.rues.org.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three proposed corporate names via the RUES pre-formation wizard; pay the name lookup fee; obtain the certificate of homonymy (certificado de homonimia) confirming availability of the company name; the certificate is valid for 30 days.
required_dossiers: Three proposed company names
Tax ID and identification of each promoter
Contact and email addresses
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If all three proposals are rejected or reserved, resubmit additional alternatives within the 30-day validity window or file a reconsideration petition with the Chamber once the rejection notice is lifted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and notarization of the incorporation document
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública (Colombian notarial registry service) or electronic authentication platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the bylaws conforming to Law 1258 of 2008; have all founding shareholders sign the private incorporation document; authenticate signatures by notarial recognition of content; for foreign corporate shareholders, legalize corporate powers and authenticate with apostille prior to signing.
required_dossiers: Legal draft of the bylaws and incorporation document
Passports or cédulas of individual shareholders
Apostilled certificate of existence and legal representation for non-resident corporate shareholders
Proof of payment of the notarial authentication fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary raises formal defects, correct, re-sign, and re-authenticate the document; if an apostille is defective, re-obtain it from the issuing country before resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial registry filing with the Chamber of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá - Registro Mercantil window / RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the authenticated incorporation document together with pre-registration forms and acceptance letters of the appointed officers; pay the registration fee (derecho de inscripción) calculated on subscribed capital; obtain the certificate of incorporation, matrícula mercantil, and Chamber-approved certificate of existence.
required_dossiers: Authenticated private incorporation document
Signed acceptance letters of appointed officers
Pre-registration RUT form (preliminary)
Payment receipt for the registration fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a query, cure the defect within the statutory 15-day correction term; if uncorrected, file a written reconsideration with the Chamber or re-present the corrected document with the applicable surcharge.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax registration and NIT issuance before DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - www.dian.gov.co
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the electronic RUT registration in DIAN's portal using the Chamber certificate; obtain the NIT (tax identification number) and RUT certificate; request the electronic signature (firma electrónica) and, if applicable, authorization of electronic invoicing; register the legal representative's tax details.
required_dossiers: Certificate of existence and legal representation from the Chamber
NIT of the legal representative
RUT pre-registration data and contact email
Minutes or ratification of the officer appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects or corrects the registration, use the electronic rectification tool in the RUT process to amend inconsistencies; if the legal representative has pending tax obligations, settle them and re-present the request.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Rúbrica of corporate books and registration of officer powers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá - registry of accounting and corporate books
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the statutory legal books - shareholders registry book, board minutes book, and partners/assembly minutes book - for opening and sealing (rúbrica) at the Chamber; simultaneously register the powers granted to the legal representative and alternate representative in the business registry.
required_dossiers: Book of registered shareholders
Minutes book of the board of directors
Minutes book of the general assembly (partners)
Appointment minutes and acceptance letters
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the books fail formal inspection, resubmit corrected books in approved formats; if registration deadlines pass, pay the late registration surcharge and submit a written explanation to the Chamber.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of corporate bank accounts and capital subscription settlement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized commercial bank in Colombia (e.g., Bancolombia, Davivienda, BBVA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the corporate account application with the registered bylaws, NIT, and identity documents of the signatories; complete the beneficial ownership declaration required under Colombian AML regulations; deposit the paid portion of the capital subscription or record the payment plan in the company's books; retain the deposit receipt for accounting purposes.
required_dossiers: Chamber certificate of incorporation and current legal representation
RUT and NIT of the company
Identity documents of the authorized signatories
Beneficial ownership declaration form (SAGRILAFT-relevant)
Evidence of capital payment or approved payment schedule
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank's compliance unit requests additional KYC information, provide certified corporate charts and source-of-funds documentation; if a signature is challenged, submit a Chamber-certified copy of the officer nomination minutes.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) - Delegatura de Propiedad Industrial
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No manufacturing or operating license is mandatory for ISIC 6420 IP patent-licensing activities; voluntary recordal of patent and trademark exploitation license agreements before the SIC for erga omnes effect (Registro de Contratos de Licencia de Explotación).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA), supported locally by the Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente de Bogotá
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Category 4 self-declaration; office-based intellectual property administration generates no industrial emissions; no full EIA report or environmental license required; only general waste management registration applies.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero process wastewater and zero VOC emissions for back-office licensing activity; compliance with Resolution 0631 of 2015 wastewater parameter tables for any sanitary discharge; general solid waste management under Decree 1077 of 2015 and hazardous waste reporting under Decree 4741 of 2005.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Obtain the occupancy and fire safety certificate (Concepto de Bomberos) from the official fire corps for the registered office; implement the occupational health and safety system (SG-SST) under Decree 1072 of 2015 and Resolution 0312 of 2019; secure a structural load and land-use concept for office occupancy.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales; official portal https://www.dian.gov.co and MUISCA transactional portal https://muisca.dian.gov.co
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: After notarial incorporation of the S.A.S. and registration with the local Chamber of Commerce (Cámara de Comercio), the entity must register electronically with DIAN's MUISCA platform to obtain the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) and the NIT (tax identification number). Required submissions include the notarized bylaws, certificate of incorporation and legal representation, proof of registered office, foreign-tax identification details, and the designated legal representative's documentation. Electronic registration automatically triggers VAT, income tax, and withholding agent obligations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia does not provide check-the-box elections permitting pass-through classification; S.A.S. corporations are mandatorily taxed as juridical persons on worldwide income with a foreign tax credit. Available elections are limited to procedural or group regimes such as the consolidated income tax filing for parent-subsidiary groups, advance pricing arrangements, and foreign tax credit carry-forward. No hybrid-mismatch entity election is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general economic-turnover threshold applies; all suppliers of taxable goods or services in Colombia, including non-resident digital-service providers, must register for VAT from the first taxable operation. A narrow exception exists only for certain occasional imports of services by non-VAT-registered individuals, not for a resident S.A.S. holding company.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (factura electrónica de venta) is integrated with DIAN's real-time fiscal clearance. Every invoice must be transmitted through DIAN-approved software or the MUISCA web/API portal, digitally signed, and obtain a valid CUFE code before issuance. Invoices cannot be suppressed or altered without transmitting an adjustment event to DIAN. Export supply chains must transmit the relevant export-service event codes to preserve the zero-rating evidence chain.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Colombia zero-rates services that qualify as servicios exportados under the Colombian Tax Code (Article 481(f), Law 1943/2018 and regulatory decrees). A Colombian licensor (CO_SAS) may zero-rate IP royalties and sub-licensing fees when the licensee is a foreign non-resident, the licensed rights are actually exploited outside Colombian territory, the service is not economically connected to Colombian assets or Colombian-end consumers, and the exporter has registered with DIAN as an export-service provider. The license agreement, royalty invoices, proof of foreign withholding tax, and technical/exploitation reports must substantiate effective external use of the IP. Documentary and factual compliance is tested at refund and audit stages.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Export of Services Registration Form (Formulario de Exportación de Servicios) submitted through DIAN MUISCA
Customs export declaration or equivalent DIAN 'Constancia de Exportación' where a customs record is generated for bundled goods-related supplies
Bill of lading, airway bill, or digital delivery certificate – only where the IP transfer is attached to tangible media or physical goods
Inward remittance certificate and SWIFT confirmation evidencing receipt of foreign currency from the non-resident licensee
Signed and notarized licensing/sub-licensing agreement and supporting royalty calculation ledger
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If DIAN determines that the zero-rating criteria were not met (e.g., the royalty is actually attributable to Colombian use, documentation is deficient, or repatriation did not occur), the assessment is clawed back to the 19% VAT liability plus default interest and a late-assessment penalty of up to 20% of the tax under Articles 634–636 of the Colombian Tax Code. Fraudulent export zero-rating claims may trigger fiscal-fraud criminal exposure and disqualification from future export regimes. Non-repatriation within 180 days adds exchange-control penalties through Banco de la República and may invalidate the exporter's registration.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (BDBR) – Junta Directiva (Central Bank Board); the exchange control regime is jointly administered with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) for supervision of authorized foreign exchange intermediaries (IMC) and with DIAN for certain exchange-control declaration and tax records.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian Peso (COP) is freely convertible for current-account operations (royalties, services, profit remittances) within the regulated Mercado Cambiario; all obligatory exchange operations must be channeled through an authorized Intermediario del Mercado Cambiario (IMC) with electronic Declaration of Exchange filing. Capital-account operations (inbound and outbound direct investment) require no prior license but must be registered with BDBR via Formulario No. 4 before returns are remitted abroad. No statutory ceiling limits profit remittance, but remittances face documentary gates: current Form 4/5 registration, tax withholding at source paid, and transfer-pricing documentation for related-party royalty streams; conversion is executed at the free IMC market rate or at the TRM rate published by BDBR for accounting and tax purposes.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Goods-export proceeds: 80% of FOB value must be channeled through an IMC within 6 months of shipment. Service and IP-royalty export proceeds (the CO_SAS primary inbound stream from foreign sub-licensees): 100% of the invoiced value must be channeled through an IMC within 6 months of service delivery. Channeling does not compel conversion: funds may be retained in domestic foreign-currency accounts or in BDBR-registered compensation accounts; only the routing through the IMC and the exchange declaration are mandatory. Non-compliance may trigger monetary fines under Law 9 of 1991 enforced by the SFC and DIAN within their respective competences.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (annual commercial registration renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Each fiscal year on or before March 31 (for entities filing annual financial statements with the Chamber)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers a default fine calculated in UVT per day of delay under Código de Comercio Article 692; continued non-renewal may result in suspension or cancellation of commercial registration and involuntary strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Aprobación de Estados Financieros de fin de ejercicio (shareholders' approval of annual financial statements)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate records and subsequently filed with Cámara de Comercio; no receipt by tax authority unless audited
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than March 31 of the year following the fiscal year; shareholders' meeting must be held by that date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to adopt financial statements and maintain the supporting minute book may invalidate dividend declarations, expose directors to liability, and affect the renewal of commercial registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración Anual de Beneficiarios Finales (UBO annual declaration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within the first two months of each calendar year (January 1 – February 28/29) pursuant to Resolution 000164 of 2020
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or inaccurate UBO filing is subject to penalties under Estatuto Tributario Article 651, including fines up to 10,000 UVT and default interest.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta y Complementarios (annual corporate income tax return, Form 210)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between April 7 and May 10 of the following year, or per the calendar established by DIAN Resolution based on the last two digits of the NIT
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty equals 5% of tax payable or 1% of gross equity for zero taxpayers, plus monthly interest; late payment accrues default interest; deliberate omission may give rise to criminal tax proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Información Exógena Anual (annual third-party and tax-relevant information return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally May 10 – June 20 per DIAN Resolution; exact window determined annually by the last two digits of the taxpayer's NIT
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Sanctions under Estatuto Tributario Article 651: up to 20,000 UVT for inaccurate or incomplete information and up to 10,000 UVT for late filing, plus default interest.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración Informativa y Documentación de Precios de Transferencia (transfer pricing return and supporting local file)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in June according to NIT-based DIAN calendar; must be filed before the transfer-pricing information return deadline for the preceding fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or misstatement allows DIAN to penalize up to 20,000 UVT and to make transfer adjustments with corresponding interest and penalties; where no transfer-pricing report is filed, the taxpayer may be barred from using certain credits and deductions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración y Pago Anual del Impuesto de Industria y Comercio (ICA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda of the municipality in which the S.A.S. is domiciled (e.g., Bogotá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Per municipal annual calendar, typically April for prior-year activity (Bogotá uses the April May schedule; exact date assigned to the taxpayer's registration number)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties and default interest under the Estatuto Tributario Distrital; continued non-compliance can lead to administrative garnishment and municipal enforcement actions.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A S.A.S. must appoint an independent certified public accountant as Revisor Fiscal (statutory auditor) when total assets exceed 5,000 SMMLV (approx. COP 7,100 million in 2025) or gross revenues exceed 3,000 SMMLV (approx. COP 4,270 million in 2025). Even below this threshold, statutes may require a Revisor Fiscal, and audits become mandatory if the Superintendencia de Sociedades orders it or where the company's by-laws, shareholder agreement, or financing covenants require audited financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: NIIF / IFRS as incorporated by Law 1314 of 2009. Entities meeting Group 1 criteria apply full IFRS; most S.A.S. IP-licensing vehicles that fall within Group 2 apply NIIF para PYMES (IFRS for SMEs) in Colombia. Books must be kept in Colombian pesos (COP) using the functional currency framework.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Within the first two months of each calendar year, the S.A.S. must file with DIAN the annual UBO declaration identifying all ultimate beneficial owners with a 15% or greater ownership or control threshold, or as required under Resolution 000164 of 2020. Any transfer of shares must be promptly recorded in the Register of Members and, if the transfer affects control or the beneficial-ownership map, the UBO declaration and the commercial registration at the Cámara de Comercio must be updated accordingly.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors (Libro de Registro de Junta Directiva or equivalent)
Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas)
Board of Directors Minute Book (if a board exists)
Register of Revisor Fiscal appointment and related certificates (if applicable)

stage_6.statutory_headline_rate: 30% for fiscal years beginning on or after 1 January 2025; 35% applied for FY2023 and FY2024 (Law 2277 of 2022). A 3% surtax applies to certain extractive sectors only—not to IP licensing.
stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No preferential IP-box regime: patent/trademark royalty income is taxed as ordinary income at the headline rate. Relevant incentives: (i) 25% CIT credit on qualifying investments in science, technology and innovation (Art. 256-1 E.T.), plus full deductible expense treatment for the same outlay; (ii) indefinite NOL carryforward with a 25%-of-taxable-income annual cap; (iii) dividend income received from Colombian operating subsidiaries is exempt from the SAS's income tax (Art. 49 E.T.) when the distributing company has paid the related CIT. The effective rate on licensor EBITDA therefore normally equals 30% (35% in FY2023–FY2024).
stage_6.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Indefinite carryforward for losses generated since FY2017 (Art. 147 E.T.); each year's offset is capped at 25% of the current-year ordinary taxable income; capital losses can offset capital gains at the differential rate.
